values.note: All nine sites first come, first served; pay at the self-pay fee tube (cash/check) or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay (+$1.50 per transaction, at most 3 nights per transaction). Stay limit 14 days within any 30. Run by the Forest Service (Hector Ranger District), not a concessionaire.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168529 (notice: 'All sites are available on a first come-first served basis'; 'Fees are payable at self-pay fee station'; 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days within a 30 day period'; is_commercially_managed false) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('Fee Tube (cash/check only ...)'; 'Recreation.gov Scan & Pay App** (additional $1.50 Service Fee per transaction; 3-night reservation maximum per transaction'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Open mid-May through November. The forest says designated campgrounds are no longer maintained after the summer season: sites may be inaccessible and restrooms unavailable.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168529 (notice: 'Open Season: Mid May - November') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('Designated campgrounds are no longer maintained after the summer recreation season ... some sites may not be accessible and amenities, such as restrooms and water, may not be available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Designed for tents or small campers under 24 feet long.' Each site has a fire pit, tent pad, picnic table and parking for up to two cars.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('There are nine campsites available. Each has a fire pit, a tent pad, a picnic table, and parking for up to two cars. This campground is designed for tents or small campers under 24 feet long'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('two handicap accessible vault toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site') + recreation.gov notice ('No drinking water available'), read 2026-10-21

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night') + recreation.gov notice ('$15 per site per night'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/gmfl/recreation/blueberry-patch-campground ('"Senior" or "Access" America the Beautiful Pass holders can apply a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS / Finger Lakes National Forest (Hector Ranger District), beside the large highbush and lowbush blueberry patch it is named for, on Picnic Area Road (County Route 2). --Claude
summary: FS page and recreation.gov confirm 9 FCFS sites for campers under 24 ft, $15/night (FS-run, self-pay or Scan & Pay), no drinking water, vault toilets, phone (607) 546-4470. NEW: 14-in-30-day limit, season mid-May to November, Senior/Access 50% stated on the page. No current forest alert touches it (the FR 264 closure is in Vermont). Note: dropped restatements and the stale '$10/night'.
